task: Loom (Sean's own account): list every video in the library so Jax can archive any it has not already saved, then delete all of them and empty Loom's trash

steps.human: Sign in to Loom in this tab. Press Done when you see your video library.

steps.do: Open My Videos (and each folder and space Sean owns). Scroll to the end of every list and report each video's share id and title. Change nothing.
Wait in the chat. Jax archives every reported id outside the browser and says when the archive is complete and verified.
Library: use bulk select to select videos for deletion, one page or folder at a time. Do not press Delete.

steps.human: Check the selection. Press Delete yourself and confirm, then Done. Repeat with Jax until the library is empty.
Open Loom's Trash, press Delete forever / Empty trash yourself and confirm, then Done.

accept: My Videos, every folder and the Trash are empty. Jax spot-checks a few share URLs and gets Loom's not-found page.
notes: Every delete is a human step: Jax selects, Sean presses the button.
Sign-in may run on id.atlassian.com, which is deliberately off the allow list, so the extension lets go of the tab while the person signs in.
Videos are archived from their public share URLs outside the browser, so the extension never downloads anything.
No save_secret step: nothing here creates a credential.
